# Proverbs 14 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 14:2 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | One-walking in-his-uprightness fears YHWH, but-[one]-devious in-his-ways despises-Him. |
| LOGOS | Whoever walks in uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is devious in his ways despises Him. |
| PNEUMA | If you walk with integrity, you honor the LORD. If you're crooked in how you live, you're showing contempt for Him. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| Translator | Rendering |

| EMET | In-[the]-mouth-of a-fool [is] a-rod-of pride, but-[the]-lips-of [the]-wise preserve-them. |
| LOGOS | By the mouth of a fool comes a rod for his back, but the lips of the wise will preserve them. |
| PNEUMA | A fool's arrogant words invite punishment, but the wise protect themselves by how they speak. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
